summary.intent: Build the alert agent for the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge: analyse Soony's confidential supplier data, then provide critical-alert channels (email, phone calls, PWA push with voice conversation) and feed supplier replies back into decision cards, integrated with the team's dashboard.
summary.outcome: Built and deployed a unified alert agent on branch jonas/alert-agent (pushed): real verifier cards, GPT-Realtime voice in the inbox, installable PWA with push and cookie login, supplier replies matched back to cards, and phone-call webhooks. The last step merged the old watcher server into one app server with background loops and tests, with the tunnel repointed.

repo: Challenge data is confidential: keep it in gitignored data/, never commit it, and never put real addresses or personal details in tests, docs or commits (use example.com placeholders).
CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md rules: no em dashes, commit as the team author, no attribution trailers, one commit per topic, and ask before every push or PR.
Entire needs `entire brain setup && entire brain connect` (Brainstore connected) before pushing; `entire brain setup` rewrites CLAUDE.md, so restore it and keep it out of the commit.
The portal API has no notification or webhook endpoint; change detection must poll /api/v1/files and compare SHA-256, since files are replaced under the same name.
Inbox cards come from data/store/*cards*.json; the verifier on integration/verifier writes real cards with to_email, while Akshat's fixture caused the example.com addresses.
Akshat's tests failed when BasicAuth read .env, so auth is only active when ASK_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD is in the process environment.
Twilio trial accounts accept only the Url param (not inline Twiml), and German/Belgian numbers need a business regulatory bundle; a US number was used instead.

The OpenAI Realtime SIP flow needs a project-level webhook (realtime.call.incoming) and noise tuning (near_field reduction, server_vad threshold 0.8, interrupt_response false, English-only transcription).
Supplier agents reply by email within about 4 minutes, so replies can be demonstrated live.

code.finding: Replaced the browser basic-auth prompt with a /login form and 30-day cookie, because iPhone home-screen PWAs show a white screen on a 401; the form body is parsed manually to avoid a multipart dependency.
Mints an OpenAI Realtime client secret per card and builds the instructions from card fields; a hold-to-talk mode was tried and removed in favour of hands-free.
Polls the mailbox read-only each minute and matches replies to sent mails by thread, falling back to subject plus sender, then attaches a summary to the card, feed and push.
Twilio/ElevenLabs/OpenAI call webhooks moved into a router on the main API so only one server is needed.
Starts the portal watcher and escalation loops inside the app process.

workflow: Run the analysis through a subagent for bulk cross-checking (200 confirmations, 59 scans), then keep the findings in local gitignored notes.
Merging teammates' branches revealed conflicts only where both sides added lines; keeping both resolved them quickly.
A tmux server loads code at start, so switching branches under it can break webhooks; restart servers after branch changes.
Check live behaviour through the Cloudflare tunnel after every change.

friction: The PWA showed a white screen on reopen because home-screen apps cannot use basic auth.
Background speech was transcribed as Chinese characters and interrupted the realtime assistant; several noise-tuning rounds were needed.
Twilio trial limits, number compliance and KYC delayed phone calls; an automated script bought a US number without asking after the German purchase failed.
A real alert email was accidentally sent to a personal address, so alert emails became opt-in.
Branch sprawl (jonas/alerts, jonas/voice-dashboard) caused confusion and had to be merged into one branch.
Inbox initially showed Akshat's example.com fixture cards instead of real data.
Transcript lines rendered below the assistant's answer until ordering was fixed.
The 14:00 data analysis was stale within 37 minutes because new drops arrived unannounced.
open_items: Automatic escalation: critical card sends a push, then a Twilio/GPT-Realtime call if unanswered within N minutes, wired to cards.
Test the PWA, push delivery and transcript ordering on a real iPhone.
Add a revise_draft tool so the draft mail can be changed during the voice conversation.
Tell Akshat the alert agent sits on his dashboard and can be merged; the new unified-server commit still needs an OK to push.
Hand-in items due Sun 12:00: demo script, 3-minute video, README paragraph on the alert agent, deployment.
Pass the Hwaseong finding to the verifier owner: 20,000 cards arrive Tue 24 Nov, after launch, so allocation or Boise are the only options.
Upgrade the Entire Graph plugin and refresh the brain index; a German number is not possible as an individual.
Consider more conservative turn detection if the room noise still triggers the assistant.
